messages.subject: Saudi Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Fisheye Executive Search Team,

Your Riyadh-based executive-search work across government, semi-government and private-sector leadership makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where institutional relationships, responsible development, regulatory strategy and coordinated execution are central to enterprise performance. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
